title: Solar Controls Heating Control Downloader (HCDownloader)
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW UNCONTROLLED SEARCH PATH ELEMENT CWE-427 An uncontrolled search path element has been identified, which could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on a target system using a malicious DLL file. CVE-2017-9646 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 7.8 has been assigned; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ). RESEARCHER Karn Ganeshen reported this vulnerability to ICS-CERT. BACKGROUND Critical Infrastructure Sector(s): Energy Countries/Areas Deployed: Unknown Company Headquarters Location: Czech Republic This product is provided subject to this  Notification  and this  Privacy & Use  policy.
